episodes.title: Escaping the World's Most Dangerous Cults | Full Documentary
episodes.description:
Cults Taboos and Twisted Faith

In this documentary, survivors, investigators and cult experts reveal the shocking reality behind some of the world's most dangerous cults. From psychological manipulation and mind control to sexual abuse, financial exploitation and brutal violence, this film uncovers how charismatic leaders destroy lives while hiding behind religion and ideology.

Hear firsthand accounts from former members who escaped years of control, discover the horrifying crimes linked to notorious cults, and learn why experts believe these organizations remain a growing threat today.

This documentary contains real survivor testimony and discussions of disturbing crimes.

episodes.title: Escape from Hell: A Terrifying Cult Survival Story | Full Documentary
episodes.description:
At the age of 19 Samuel Stefan, consumed by crisis, was drawn into a cult. It would be 10 years before he was able to escape. Using a technique called ‘love-bombing’ cults prey on the vulnerable, recruiting new members with love and warmth. After a period of brain-washing, members are forbidden to leave, enslaved through psychological control or even violence. With full access to six escaped cult members, as well as experts, Cult Witness unravels the hidden world of cults; the hold they have on their victims, the reasons people form and fall prey to them and what takes place within.
